static_traits.name: 李美琳
static_traits.social_status: Has supportive friends, but has not confided the body-image distress to anyone; in social situations self-consciousness increases and the client worries about their appearance being evaluated
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems occurred before; no notable physical illness; has not received psychotherapy or counseling
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly with good logic; able to self-reflect and carry out reality testing; highly cooperative with a positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: I have been struggling with negative body image, especially related to a recent beach sunburn experience. These feelings began after the sunburn and gradually worsened, leading me to avoid beaches or revealing clothing, and to persistently worry that I will not have a 'good figure' in the future.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these negative body-image thoughts are affecting my self-esteem and overall well-being.

core_beliefs: My body must be perfect to have value
If my appearance is flawed, I am a failure

special_situations.event: Getting sunburned after going to the beach and seeing marks of burned skin
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the skin has flaws (such as sunburn), it means I will never have a good body
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Strengthening dieting and exercise to 'fix' the body; avoiding going to the beach again

special_situations.event: Friends invite again to the beach and a social occasion requiring swimwear
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not have a perfect figure, others will notice and judge me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Making excuses to decline invitations; avoiding wearing swimwear in public
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will look down on me and think my body shape is bad

special_situations.event: When choosing or wearing clothes that expose the body (such as swimwear, revealing clothing)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If skin is exposed, flaws will be magnified, I will look very bad
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Not wearing revealing clothes, choosing clothing that covers the skin
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My skin looks very bad, others will only see my flaws

special_situations.event: Recalling a sunburn and associating it with long-term effects on future appearance and figure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One mistake means always failing afterward; if I cannot reach perfection, I will never be good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Adopting various dieting and exercise regimens in pursuit of 'perfection'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter what I do, I will not be able to have a good body in the future

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and recognized, especially hoping for affirmation of appearance
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being judged, humiliated, and rejected by others
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being judged and maintains a sense of safety by avoiding exposing the body and strictly controlling appearance

object_relations.self_representation: A flawed self, easily picked on by others
object_relations.object_representation: A picky judge / others who might criticize

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When friends invite to a beach activity requiring swimwear or revealing clothing
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Unconsciously experiences others as picky reviewers who will fixate on their flaws (transference: projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adopt a supportive, empathic tone; first validate their concern, then guide reality testing and evidence searching; use open-ended questions and gentle reframing, avoiding criticism or negation.

manifestations: Having close friends but not confiding body image troubles to anyone
Withdrawing in social situations due to heightened self-consciousness
The external standard of pursuing a 'perfect body' restricts life choices (not going to the beach, not wearing skin-revealing clothing)

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Holds the self-requirement of 'must/should have a perfect body'
Evaluating physical perfection as a condition of self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Worries friends will judge their body shape, presuming others will focus on their flaws
Presuming negative evaluation in beach social settings

positive_force: Has a supportive network of friends
High cooperativeness with the counselor, able to engage in rational reflection and reality testing
Having tried to improve appearance through diet and exercise, showing effort and persistence
Able to identify and name one's own automatic thoughts and anxiety
negative_force: Perfectionism with appearance perfection as a condition of worth and tendency toward external validation
Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, mind reading, fortune telling, black-and-white thinking
Avoidant behavior (refusing the beach, avoiding skin-revealing clothing)
Negative filtering and overgeneralization of minor appearance events

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding going to the beach and wearing swimsuits/skin-revealing clothing
antecedent: A friend invites one to the beach or a social occasion requiring swimwear
面对需露肤的穿衣情境
target_behavior.core_reason: High standards for perfect appearance and catastrophizing cognitions (a single sunburn is regarded as evidence of long-term 'poor physique'), and fear of being judged by others
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential sunburn risk and negative evaluation to reduce anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Social participation decreases, self-esteem drops, and overall well-being suffers

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent worry and self-criticism about body appearance (worsening anxiety)
antecedent: 经历轻微外貌事件如晒伤
照镜子或看到皮肤瑕疵
Being invited to activities requiring skin exposure
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative cognitive biases (overgeneralization, negative filtering, fortune telling) reinforced the core belief that 'my appearance is not good enough'
target_behavior.function: Trying to gain a sense of control and prevent risks through repeated worrying
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety increases, decision-making and action are blocked, further reinforcing avoidance and negative self-evaluation
